subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 4: Language practice – in, on, under + Sound sh
outcomes: I can say where things are with in, on and under.
I can say chair, desk, floor and wall.
I can hear the sh sound in ship, shop and shell.

tf.s: The bag is on the floor means the bag is down on the floor.
The cat is under the desk means the cat is on top of the desk.
tf.why: Under means below. On means on top.

tf.s: Pencils in the pot are inside the pot.
Ship starts with the sh sound.
Sun starts with the sh sound.
tf.why: Sun starts with s. Shop starts with sh.

tf.s: Fish ends with the sh sound.
tf.why: Well done! Fi-sh ends with sh.

tf.s: sh – o – p makes the word ship.
tf.why: sh-o-p makes shop. sh-i-p makes ship.

tf.s: A wall is part of the classroom.
We can put a pencil on a desk.
tf.why: Yes! The pencil is on the desk.

tf.s: Under and on mean the same.
tf.why: On is on top. Under is below.

boxes.q: The cat is below the desk. The cat is … the desk.
The pencils are inside the pot. They are … the pot.
sh – i – p. What's the word?

boxes.why: We put books on the desk.

boxes.q: Where's the bag? (It is on the floor.)
boxes.why: The bag is on the floor.
Under tells us where a thing is.

boxes.q: Which one is a sea animal with sh?
boxes.why: A shark lives in the sea.

hunt.q: You put your feet on the …

mcq.q: Which of these words starts with sh?
mcq.why: Shirt starts with sh. Fish ends with sh.

mcq.q: Which one is part of the classroom?
mcq.why: The wall is part of the classroom.

mcq.q: Which two letters make the sh sound?
mcq.why: S and h together say sh.

mcq.q: Your pencil is on top of your desk. Where is it?
Listen: sh – e – d. What's the word?
The crayon is inside the bag. Which sentence is right?
o: The crayon is in the bag.
The crayon is on the bag.
The crayon is under the bag.
The bag is in the crayon.
mcq.why: Inside the bag means in the bag.

mcq.q: Which word has sh at the end, not the start?
mcq.why: Fish ends with sh. The others start with sh.

mcq.q: The cat is on the chair. Now it jumps down below the chair. Where is it now?
mcq.why: Below the chair means under the chair.

mcq.q: Which group of words all start with sh?
mcq.why: Shop, shed and sheep all start with sh.
